_about: The audition set: real lines from the products (Sick Of It Assets/GameConfig/audio.json, Dose Of Destruction content/voice.json and sounds.json). tools/audition.mjs runs each voice line through every open voice model and ElevenLabs, each sound through the open SFX model and ElevenLabs, and lays them side by side with LUFS, clipping, silence, loop and intelligibility checks.

voices.text: Oh, great. More of them. You know what, I had plans today. Big plans. Lying on the couch, ignoring the whole world, eating cereal for dinner. And instead I'm out here. Shooting slime. Fantastic.
voices.description: A tired, grumpy hero in their thirties who is completely sick of everything. Low, slightly raspy voice with dry, deadpan delivery; sarcastic and unimpressed, muttering one-liners under their breath like a stand-up comedian. Natural, close-mic studio recording, American accent.

voices.text: Welcome, challenger! Get ready for the most intense, the most ridiculous, the most infernal battle of your entire life! Level one, begin! Final wave! Oh yeah, now we're talking!
voices.description: Over-the-top retro arcade game announcer: booming, energetic and larger than life, slightly cheesy, big punchy emphasis on every word, like a 1990s arcade cabinet. Clean, loud studio recording, American accent.

voices.text: [booming] FLATTENED! [pause] WHAT A FINISH... [laughs] FOR HELL!
voices.description: Over-the-top retro arcade game announcer: booming, energetic and larger than life, slightly cheesy, big punchy emphasis on every word, like a 1990s arcade cabinet. Clean, loud studio recording, American accent.

voices.text: Mm. [long pause] Stay. [pause] Another one. They always come up to look. A thousand floors, and every one of them the same. Fire. Screaming. The same fire. The same screaming. Forever. I have heard it all. [sighs] The surface will be quieter. Move. Or don't. It makes no difference to me.
voices.description: An enormous ancient titan, the ruler of Hell: a very deep, slow, resonant bass voice, huge and calm, barely bothered, bored and tired of everything. Never raises his voice; every word sounds like it cost him nothing. Long pauses, low and heavy, a slight gravelly rumble. Clean studio recording, no effects, neutral accent.

voices.text: I came for the exit. Turns out it was the main event.
voices.description: Young man, wry and tired but sure of himself, a punk who has seen the whole show; dry, low, understated delivery.
A small, curt, flat robot voice that has had enough of talking.

sfx.text: A low monstrous growl from a huge creature, rumbling and wet, with a rising snarl at the end. One-shot, dry, no music.
A punchy user interface confirm, a bright click with a short rising tone. One-shot.
A single heavy boot footstep on gravel, crunchy, close-up, dry. One-shot.
Small cartoon explosion: a punchy low boom with a quick crackle and a short debris tail. One-shot, no music.
A calm, quiet night ambience: soft wind, distant crickets and a faint low hum, seamless loop, no music, no sudden sounds.

music.text: Heavy boss battle theme for a fighting game, pounding drums, distorted guitars and a menacing synth bass, 150 BPM, no vocals, loopable.
music.note: Existing audio.music (ACE-Step 1.5 XL); the audition runs it through audio.music-loop and the loop-point check
